# Fluxwright (`v0.14.0`)

> Apache-2.0 3-tier hybrid browser fleet engine for Rust, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, HTTP/CDP, and MCP. Designed to run hundreds of isolated Chromium jobs, AI agent workflows, web scrapers, and parallel E2E tests on your own machines.

Website: https://fluxwright.vercel.app
Repository: https://github.com/harshit-d3v/fluxwright

## Key Capabilities

- **3-tier execution engine:**
  - **Tier 1 (HTTP fast path):** pure-Rust `rustls` + `ring` HTTP/HTTPS fetcher and `html5ever` Markdown/link extractor with per-hop DNS-pinned SSRF protection for static `/v1/scrape` and `/v1/map` jobs (zero Chromium launched).
  - **Tier 2 (optional external light-CDP):** `--fast-cdp-endpoint` routes non-visual escalated jobs to external lightweight CDP engines (such as Lightpanda, Moli, or Obscura) with graceful `-32601` fallback and zero AGPL entanglement.
  - **Tier 3 (pooled Chromium fleet):** `BrowserEngine` pools `chrome-headless-shell` or Chrome processes, creates a fresh browser context per job, admits work against real process-tree RSS ceilings, recycles bloated browsers cleanly with drain, enforces per-host rate limits, and automatically retries jobs when a browser crashes.
- **Playwright-style APIs without Node driver hops:** native Rust core with in-process Node.js (`napi-rs`) and Python (`PyO3`, both `asyncio` `async_playwright` and `sync_playwright`) bindings (`goto`, `getByRole`, `getByText`, `locator` piercing open Shadow DOM, `frameLocator`, `page.route`, `page.clock`, `storageState`, `screenshot`, `pdf`, `connectOverCDP`).
- **Complete Chromium E2E testing built in:** auto-retrying `expect()`, Playwright-compatible `.zip` `context.tracing` (inspect in Playwright Trace Viewer), `recordVideo` + `page.video()`, visual `toHaveScreenshot()` pixel diffs, `fluxwright/test` (`fluxwright-test` CLI with `--workers`, `--shard`, `--retries`, HTML/JSON/list reporters), and an auto-loaded `pytest` plugin.
- **Self-hosted Cloud Browser & Scraping Server (`fluxwright serve`):** managed `/v1/sessions` with Live View HITL embed URLs and 15-minute replay/HAR export, `/v1/scrape`, `/v1/map`, `/v1/jobs`, pooled WebSocket `/cdp` gateway, SQLite WAL persistence (`--store`), persistent profiles (`--profiles-dir`), rotating proxy cooldown pool, signed webhooks, Prometheus `/metrics`, OTLP traces, and multi-machine `fluxwright coordinate` clustering.
- **AI Agent & MCP tooling (`fluxwright-mcp`):** 22-tool stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP server featuring `@eN@rK` accessibility snapshots with revision guardrails, diff snapshots (`{ diff: true }`), Set-of-Marks screenshots (`{ annotate: true }`), clean Markdown extraction, and `export_api_calls` (`json` / `curl`).

## Honest Boundaries

- **Chromium / HTTP only:** no Firefox or WebKit (Safari) engines. Use Playwright or Selenium if Firefox/Safari testing or Java/C#/Ruby bindings are required.
- **No GUI codegen or hosted Trace Viewer UI:** writes standard Playwright-compatible `.zip` traces for local/CI inspection.
- **No anti-bot or CAPTCHA evasion.**
